svg.aria-label: Rail-optimized Scalable Unit: NIC n of every node → Leaf n
svg.title: Rail-optimized Scalable Unit: NIC n of every node → Leaf n
svg.text: Rail-optimized Scalable Unit: NIC n of every node → Leaf n
32 DGX H100 × 8 ConnectX-7 = 256 node→leaf cables; rail 0 highlighted end to end
8 leaves in the SU network rack — one per NIC index, NOT one per server rack
Path for GPU 0 (dgx01) → GPU 0 (dgx32): mlx5_0 → Leaf 0 → mlx5_0 — ONE switch hop, spine idle
Cross-rail (GPU 0 → GPU 3 on another node): Leaf 0 → spine → Leaf 3 — three hops, unless PXN first moves the data to GPU 3's NIC over NVLink

g.title: Arithmetic: 32 nodes × 8 rails = 256 node→leaf cables; each leaf takes 32 downlinks (ports 1–32) and keeps 32 for uplinks.

svg.text: Arithmetic: 32 nodes × 8 rails = 256 node→leaf cables; each leaf takes 32 downlinks (ports 1–32) and keeps 32 for uplinks.
As built: 31 nodes + 4 UFM ports = 252 downlinks. Verify a rail with iblinkinfo -S <leaf-GUID> → every remote is mlx5_N.
